---
title: "EADM Funding"
---

EADM puts its membership fees back into the field. The Association funds
individual travel through the Jane Beattie Memorial Travel Scholarship, funds
meetings through its workshop grants, and trains the next generation of
researchers through the EADM Summer School.

## Jane Beattie Memorial Travel Scholarship

The Beattie Scholarship subsidises travel between Europe and North America for
scholarly activity in judgment and decision research, broadly defined.
Attending the SPUDM or the annual SJDM meeting is one example of a qualifying
activity, but by no means the only one. The fund was established in memory of
SJDM and EADM member Jane Beattie and her contributions to the field, and is
sponsored jointly by both associations — EADM sponsors the awards made to its
own members, including student members.

[About the scholarship and how to apply](jane-beattie-travel-scholarship.qmd)

## Workshop grants

To keep the field active in the two-year gap between SPUDM conferences, EADM
sponsors up to two workshops or similar events per year, each to a maximum of
EUR 3,000. The main organiser must be a full EADM member, the meeting must be
open to EADM members at a reduced fee, and a report has to be published on this
website afterwards. Applications go to the Treasurer by **31 January**, and a
decision follows the board meeting in mid-March of the same year.

[Full conditions, and reports from past workshops](workshop-grants/index.qmd)

## EADM Summer School

The Summer School is a week-long residential course for PhD students and pre-
and early post-doctoral researchers, hosted roughly every two years by a
European institution — so far Essex, Bonn, Amsterdam, Salzburg and Berlin. Its
focus is methodological rather than topical: past programmes have covered open
science, replicability and reproducibility, cognitive and Bayesian modelling,
process tracing and eye-tracking, and the design and analysis of decision
experiments. Each edition is taught by invited faculty from across the
association and concludes with a published report.

[Reports from past summer schools](summer-school/index.qmd)
